# Neorama Studios

> Neorama Studios is a Mumbai-based creative agency producing brand films, photography, social media content, and branding & design for startups and small-to-medium brands. Founded and led by Sumit Bhandari (Creative Director & Director of Photography).

Neorama Studios is a full-service creative production studio — film, photography, branding, and social/marketing content, all under one roof. Based in Andheri West, Mumbai; serves clients across India. Working hours: Mon–Sat, 09:30–18:30 IST. Contact: sumit@neoramastudios.com, +91 97131 02046.

## Services
- [Brand Film Production, Mumbai](https://www.neoramastudios.com/brand-films-mumbai/): Brand story films, founder films and product films for startups and D2C brands.
- [Corporate Video Production, Mumbai](https://www.neoramastudios.com/corporate-video-production-mumbai/): Company profiles, explainers, testimonials and event films.
- [Social Media & Influencer Content, Mumbai](https://www.neoramastudios.com/social-media-content-agency-mumbai/): Instagram Reels, short-form video and influencer campaigns.
- [Commercial Photography, Mumbai](https://www.neoramastudios.com/commercial-photography-mumbai/): Product, fashion, food, brand and architecture photography.
- [Branding & Design, Mumbai](https://www.neoramastudios.com/branding-design-agency-mumbai/): Brand identity, packaging and design systems.

- [Food & Beverage Photography](https://www.neoramastudios.com/projects/photography/food-beverage): Food and drink photography for restaurants, cafés, bars and pubs, bakeries, patisseries and dessert shops, and packaged food & beverage brands (Boom Burger, Costa Coffee, French Affair, Irish House, Mad Over Donuts, Mushmerry, Pizza Express, Raw Pressery, Sakheti).
